add-constraint: The widened notification kind and entity-type CHECKs are added NOT VALID without scanning existing notifications, under 1s lock_timeout and 5s statement_timeout; the online phase validates them after the schema lock is released.
add-foreign-key: Foreign keys are added to the new empty reminder table without an existing-row scan; lock acquisition on the referenced chat, organization and user tables is bounded by 1s lock_timeout and each statement by 5s statement_timeout.
row-level-security: ENABLE and FORCE RLS change only catalog flags on the new empty reminder table before application traffic can use it, under 1s lock_timeout and 5s statement_timeout.
create-policy: The reminder table's policies are installed on the new empty table without reading application rows, under 1s lock_timeout and 5s statement_timeout.
